cohort: 996 macrosomic infants born over a 6 year period at a single hospital.
finding: Macrosomic infants born to diabetic mothers had an increased risk of several complications including hospital admission, intensive care admission, hypoglycemia, jaundice, respiratory distress, and asphyxia.
mod_finding: Diabetic mothers had a higher cesarean section rate (52.4% vs 31.1%, p<0.05).
